gaps.sentence: The matter ___ at this very moment, so no comment yet.
gaps.explanation: Look into (investigate) passivises with the particle kept: is being looked into.

gaps.sentence: The recipe ___ (pass down) from generation to generation.
gaps.hint: continuing relevance from past to now
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + passed down; the process links past and present.

gaps.sentence: The novel ___ (write) in under three months.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive (was/were + past participle): was written. The writer is not mentioned.

gaps.sentence: The house is ___ (sell) on Tuesday unless a buyer comes forward first.
gaps.explanation: 'Be + passive infinitive' (is to be sold) expresses an official arrangement.

gaps.sentence: She ___ (think) to be the finest violinist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive: is thought to be. The thinkers are general, not stated.

gaps.sentence: The fault ___ by the time the auditor arrived.
gaps.explanation: The fixing preceded the arrival: past perfect passive had been + fixed.

gaps.sentence: All new students ___ (give) a locker key on their first day.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + given. Passives of give keep the indirect object as subject.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (notify) by email at the end of the week.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + notified for the plural subject 'the winners'.
